Urgent MCH/SAM/VPR threats retain priority without restarting the window. The same held-or-fresh physical generation, exact target, complete blocker matrix, native 10y/LoS, one-attempt, and no-retry boundaries remain. MIRACLE LANDED proves status application, not an interrupt. Configuration schema 16 migrates the new subtype off.
